overview: A postal system for villages: buy a mailbox from the village Mail Person, write to other players with an item attached, and get deliveries, gifts and village news.
It needs Pandorical on the server and on the client; without it you get a chat message instead of a mail screen.

1.0.2: A Mail Person caught by a zombie now wears a zombie Mail Person's own look, instead of the missing texture that used to stand in for it.
1.0.1: Mail held for a player with no mailbox can be collected at any public mailbox or asked for from a Mail Person, and the notice now says where it is waiting.
Villagers only write to people they actually know, and a spilt bucket no longer washes a mailbox away.
1.0.0: The first release: personal and public mailboxes, letters with an attachment to anyone who has played on the server, and a notice board carrying the weather and the deaths of villagers nearby.
Donations go to Village Builder's next project, an unread count sits in the corner of the screen, and post offices generate with a chest worth opening.
